node.title: Re: substr odd behavior with list arguments
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I care because I'd like to do this: substr($string,a_subroutine_call_that_returns_offset_and_length(@some_args))

You can get Perl to ignore the prototype (that was [id://11130136|explained] by [choroba]) on Perl 5.16 and up via: &CORE::substr("abcdefg",@a)
